title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay New-Destination Screening Hold and First-Order Ceiling
content:
A first Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order to a destination the customer has not paid before is limited in value and held for screening before it is submitted. The ceiling and the hold are set per product.

| Product | Largest value of a first order to a new destination (USD) | Screening hold before submission |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | $50.00 | 0 minutes |
| Paloma Data Bundle | $25.00 | 0 minutes |
| Paloma Electricity Token | $100.00 | 30 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | $500.00 | 60 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | $40.00 | 60 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | $1000.00 | 120 minutes |

## Reading the table

- A hold of 0 minutes means a first order to a new destination of Paloma Airtime Top-Up or Paloma Data Bundle is not held; its value ceiling still applies.
- For Paloma Data Bundle and Paloma Bill Pay Television the ceiling equals the largest denomination of the product ($25.00 and $40.00), so every denomination of those two products is within the first-order ceiling.

## Hypothetical first orders

| First order to a new destination | Value | Within the ceiling? | Held before submission |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | $50.00 | yes, the ceiling is $50.00 | not held (0 minutes) |
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | $60.00 | no, above $50.00 | not permitted at this value |
| Paloma Electricity Token | $100.00 | yes, the ceiling is $100.00 | 30 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | $750.00 | no, above $500.00 | not permitted at this value |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | $1000.00 | yes, the ceiling is $1000.00 | 120 minutes |
